data.one_liner: A dropdown alert package for Flutter to notify users like push notifications.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable in-app dropdown alerts that can be triggered from anywhere using a controller, similar to push notifications. Supports success, warning, and error types with customizable styling, positioning, and tap listeners.
use_when: You need in-app alerts for API success, failure, or warnings
You want to trigger notifications globally without needing a widget context
You need customizable top or bottom notification banners
avoid_when: You need actual native push notifications when the app is terminated
You require complex state management solutions for notifications
strengths: Can be shown from anywhere including blocs without widget context
Supports multiple alert types (success, warning, error) with distinct default styling
Includes features like drag to dismiss, position configuration, and custom delay dismissal
weaknesses: Requires manual setup by wrapping MaterialApp with a Stack
Limited to dropdown banner style notifications
data.setup_notes: Add DropdownAlert() inside a Stack widget within your MaterialApp builder.
